items.name: Article outline
items.description: Outline a blog post, article or talk with a working title, the main argument, sections with key points and sources to find.

items.name: Budget review
items.description: Review income and spending from a statement or spreadsheet, group it into categories and point out where money could be saved.

items.name: Bug report
items.description: Turn a vague problem description into a clear bug report with steps to reproduce, expected and actual behaviour, and environment.

items.name: Build dashboard
items.description: Build an interactive HTML dashboard with charts, filters, and tables. Use when creating an executive overview with KPI cards, turning query results into a shareable self-contained report, building a team monitoring snapshot, or needing multiple charts with filters in one browser-openable file.

items.name: Chart from data
items.description: Turn a table or CSV into a clear chart, choosing the right chart type and writing a one-line takeaway.

items.name: Code review
items.description: Review a code change for bugs first, then clarity and tests, and report findings ranked by severity with file and line.

items.name: Compare options
items.description: Compare products, services or plans side by side on what matters to the person, and recommend one with the reasons.

items.name: Competitive brief
items.description: Research competitors and write a positioning and messaging comparison with gaps, opportunities, and threats. Use for a sales battlecard, an unclaimed angle, or a competitor's move.

items.name: CSV cleanup
items.description: Clean a messy CSV file - trim spaces, normalize headers, drop empty and duplicate rows - and report what changed.

items.name: Decision memo
items.description: Write a one-page decision memo that lays out the options, trade-offs, a recommendation and what would change it.

items.name: Digest
items.description: Generate a daily or weekly digest of activity across all connected sources. Use when catching up after time away, starting the day and wanting a summary of mentions and action items, or reviewing a week's decisions and document updates grouped by project.

items.name: Word documents
items.description: Use when creating, reading, or editing a Word document (.docx or .dotx): reports, memos, letters, templates, tracked changes, comments, or find-and-replace. Not for PDFs or spreadsheets.

items.name: Doublecheck
items.description: Three-layer verification pipeline for AI output. Extracts verifiable claims, finds supporting or contradicting sources via web search, runs adversarial review for hallucination patterns, and produces a structured verification report with source links for human review.

items.name: Email drafter
items.description: Draft a clear email or reply from a few notes, matched to the reader and the tone the person wants.

items.name: Fact check
items.description: Check the claims in a text against reliable sources and mark each one as supported, wrong, misleading or unverified.

items.name: Gift ideas
items.description: Suggest thoughtful gift ideas for a person and occasion within a budget, with where to get them.

items.name: Inbox triage
items.description: Sort a pile of emails or messages into reply now, do later, read and ignore, with a one-line reason for each.

items.name: Invoice check
items.description: Check an invoice or bill against the quote, contract or order for wrong amounts, duplicates, missing details and due dates.

items.name: Meal planner
items.description: Plan a week of meals around diet, budget and time, with simple recipes and one combined shopping list.

items.name: Meeting notes
items.description: Turn a meeting transcript or rough notes into a short summary with decisions, action items and open questions.

items.name: Meeting prep
items.description: Prepare for a meeting with a short brief on the people, the goal, open items from last time and questions to ask.

items.name: PDF
items.description: Use when the person wants anything done with a PDF: read or extract text and tables, merge, split, rotate, watermark, create, fill a form, encrypt, pull images out, or OCR a scan.

items.name: PowerPoint decks
items.description: Use whenever a .pptx or .potx file is involved: create or edit a slide deck, read text out of one, combine or split slides, or work with notes and comments.

items.name: Proofread
items.description: Proofread a text for spelling, grammar, punctuation and clarity, keeping the author's voice, and list what changed.

items.name: Research brief
items.description: Research a question on the web and write a sourced brief with the answer first, key facts, disagreements and links.

items.name: Rewrite tone
items.description: Rewrite a text in a different tone or for a different reader, such as friendlier, more formal, shorter or simpler.

items.name: Social post
items.description: Turn an announcement, article or idea into short social posts sized for each network, with a few variations to choose from.

items.name: Spreadsheet formulas
items.description: Write, explain or fix spreadsheet formulas for Excel or Google Sheets from a plain-language description of what is needed.

items.name: SQL helper
items.description: Write, explain or speed up a SQL query from a plain-language question and the table structure.

items.name: Summarize document
items.description: Summarize a long document, report or contract into the key points, numbers, obligations and anything that needs attention.

items.name: Systematic debugging
items.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

items.name: Teach
items.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.

items.name: Trip planner
items.description: Plan a trip day by day within a budget, with travel times, bookings to make and a packing list.

items.name: Web app testing
items.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.

items.name: Weekly report
items.description: Write a concise weekly status report from tickets, chats and notes, grouped into done, in progress, blocked and next.

items.name: Workout plan
items.description: Build a simple weekly workout plan around goals, fitness level, equipment and time, with how to progress.

items.name: Write spec
items.description: Write a feature spec or PRD from a problem statement or feature idea. Use when turning a vague idea or user request into a structured document, scoping a feature with goals and non-goals, defining success metrics and acceptance criteria, or breaking a big ask into a phased spec.

items.name: Excel spreadsheets
items.description: Use when a spreadsheet is the main input or output: open, edit, or create .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, or .tsv files, including formulas, charts, and cleaning messy tables.
